$comment: Single source of truth for AI-assistant deep links. Every entry here was tested, not copied from a blog post. Re-run scripts/verify-endpoints.sh before any client build and update verified_on.
verified_method: Live navigation in a logged-in Chrome profile; composer contents read via getComputedStyle/DOM inspection. curl alone is NOT sufficient — every one of these apps is a client-rendered SPA that returns HTTP 200 for any query string.

platforms.label: ChatGPT
platforms.notes: hints=search forces web-search mode so free-tier users can actually fetch the URL in the prompt. Auto-submits on load — keep prompts short. Legacy chat.openai.com/?q= still redirects here. This param has broken before (Aug 2024) and was later restored; it is undocumented.

platforms.label: Claude
platforms.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-22 in a logged-in session: composer populated with the passed string, no auto-submit, URL self-cleans to /new. Logged-out users hit /login?returnTo=... and the q param survives the round trip. Anthropic officially documents the equivalent claude://claude.ai/new?q= desktop scheme with a ~14,000 char truncation limit.

platforms.label: Perplexity
platforms.notes: /search?q= 301-redirects here with q intact, so either form works; prefer /search/new. Best of the five for logged-out visitors — no auth wall.

platforms.label: Grok
platforms.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-22: the q param IS consumed — the prompt renders into the message body — but it auto-submits straight into a sign-in wall for logged-out visitors. The x.com/i/grok?text= alternative also requires an X login (param survives the redirect_after_login round trip). WEAKEST BUTTON OF THE SET: most article readers are not logged into X or grok.com and will hit an auth wall instead of an answer. Consider disabling for consumer-facing sites.

platforms.label: AI Mode
platforms.notes: udm=50 is Google AI Mode, stable through 2026. Deliberately OMIT the &aep=11 that CiteMET-derived sources append — its function could not be verified and udm=50 alone is sufficient. This is the only reachable Google surface; Gemini itself cannot be prefilled.

platforms.label: Gemini
platforms.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-22 as NOT PREFILLABLE. Tested ?q=, ?text=, ?prompt= and ?prompt_text= in a logged-in session — the composer stays .ql-blank in every case and the test string never appears. The ?prompt_text= parameter widely repeated in GEO write-ups is fabricated; do not ship it. Gemini is therefore only available in clipboard mode: copy the prompt, open Gemini, show a 'prompt copied — paste it in' toast. Requires a secure context (HTTPS) for navigator.clipboard; falls back to a textarea+execCommand shim.

excluded.reason: Microsoft DELIBERATELY DISABLED prefill in mid-January 2026 after the 'Reprompt' one-click data-exfiltration attack. copilot.microsoft.com/?q= now 302s and strips the param. Do not ship.
chat.deepseek.com returns a 202 bot-challenge; no evidence of prefill support.
chat.mistral.ai/chat?q= returns 200 but no documentation or third-party confirmation the param is consumed. Unverified — do not ship without testing.
No evidence of any prefill mechanism.

stability_warning: Every endpoint above is an undocumented surface, and the 2026 trend is REMOVAL, not addition. Copilot was killed outright in Jan 2026. Anthropic patched a prompt-injection vector through its own param. Microsoft published security research treating this whole pattern as an attack class. Never hardcode these URLs into generated post content or a database — always render them server-side or from a single filterable config so a broken provider is a one-line fix, not a re-migration.
